notes.title: Grand Fantasia Special Report: Comprehensive Update
notes.notes:
Hello players~ We are the development team of Grand Fantasia Global!

In 2008, our journey began. Do you remember the thrill of defeating the "Ancient Giant Baron" on Siwa Island? The excitement of crafting a yellow weapon, the kind old man Babama, and his spiked club? The nostalgic login screen BGM and the quirky XD crab? As we celebrate 16 years of adventures and updates, we invite players to relive these wonderful memories and explore the newly revamped continent of Saphael!

Engine Fully Upgraded
The game's graphics have been significantly enhanced, from small details like water ripples and plants to large elements like lighting and architectural scenery. Experience the fantastical beauty of the continent of Saphael once more.

Class Gameplay Returns
In recent years, adjustments to class mechanics have greatly changed players' experiences. In the Origin version, we will restore the previous gameplay basics, allowing players to reclaim their most powerful and skilled playstyles.

Multiple Optimizations and Remakes
The Origin version will feature more optimizations, including batch synthesis, quick split flow, reduced loading times, quick gear swaps, and archive search, allowing players to enjoy modern conveniences while reminiscing about past adventures.

Diverse International Translations
In addition to Chinese, the Origin version will support English and Japanese, allowing more players worldwide to join our big family.

Server Enhancements
For this global version, Grand Fantasia will support multiple languages, including Chinese, Japanese, English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese. Additionally, this version will be optimized for MAC systems, allowing smooth gameplay in a simulated environment.

New Class: Ninja
A global exclusive class, the Ninja can advance to "Secret Agent" or "Imperial Guard," gaining stronger abilities. This versatile warrior excels in various attack ranges, shuriken techniques, and mysterious spells. Originating from an exotic Eastern land, they are adept at both disrupting and assassinating enemies with dazzling moves.

Skills Adjustments
Certain skills and effects, such as "Soul Link" between couples, the "Safe Return" teleport function, and the "Life Drain" effect, are subject to adjustment or removal.

Mechanism Adjustments
To ensure resource balance, we will add entry limits to dungeons and remove repeatable quests, which previously allowed excessive accumulation of game resources.

Specialization Point Optimization
Before reaching a specified level, players can reset specialization points for free, fully refunding all points upon resetting. After surpassing the threshold level, this refund mechanism will be canceled, allowing players to adjust to their most suitable specialization style.

Other Adjustments
New appearance options, including hairstyles, skin colors, and eye colors, have been added to character creation. Additionally, quest progress adjustments, dungeon difficulty reclassification, and other updates have been made to make Grand Fantasia more suitable for the current era.

Anti-Cheat Advocacy
Grand Fantasia has implemented an anti-cheat system enhanced with new player behavior analysis and data tools to protect the rights of regular players.

The overall game adjustments are on schedule and expected to be available to players in September. Whether you are a veteran player or a new player, you are welcome to experience this fantasy adventure in Grand Fantasia!

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. Stay tuned for more updates and prepare to embark on a refreshed adventure in Grand Fantasia!
